{{short description|American mathematician|bot=PearBOT 5}}
'''Tanya Julie Christiansen''' is an American mathematician who works in [[scattering theory]] and the theory of [[partial differential equation]]s.{{r|profile}} She is Luther Marion Defoe Distinguished Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Missouri]].{{r|mishon}}

==Education and career==
Christiansen graduated ''[[Latin honors|summa cum laude]]'' in 1989 from [[Rice University]], with a bachelor's degree in mathematics.{{r|cv}} She completed her Ph.D. in 1993 at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]]. Her dissertation, ''Scattering Theory on Compact Manifolds with Boundary'', was supervised by [[Richard Burt Melrose]].{{r|mgp}}

After postdoctoral positions at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] and [[Johns Hopkins University]], she joined the University of Missouri faculty in 1995.{{r|cv}} She became Defoe Distinguished Professor in 2019.{{r|mishon}}
